title: Subscription
description: Where webhook events are delivered. Several keys are keywords in Rust, Go or TypeScript, so the generated field names show how each language escapes them.

url.description: The endpoint events are posted to.

match.description: The event types delivered to this endpoint.

default.description: True when events no other subscription matches go here.

async.description: True to deliver without waiting for the endpoint's reply.

select.description: The top-level event keys to send. Every key when absent.

self.description: The URL of this subscription in the API.
